D023: Binge eating and inappropriate compensatory behaviors are accompanied, but they are one-off or not regular.
D022: Inappropriate compensatory behaviors accompanied by binge eating are repeated regularly.

D023.key_difference: Meeting criteria for Major Depressive Disorder

D023: Binge eating and depressive symptoms may be accompanied, but diagnostic criteria for major depressive disorder are not met.
D013: Binge eating and depressive symptoms may be accompanied, but diagnostic criteria for major depressive disorder are met.

D023.key_difference: Meeting criteria for Bipolar I Disorder

D023: Binge eating and manic symptoms may be accompanied, but diagnostic criteria for bipolar I disorder are not met.
D008: Binge eating and manic symptoms may be accompanied, but diagnostic criteria for bipolar I disorder are met.

D023.key_difference: Meeting criteria for Bipolar II Disorder

D023: Binge eating and hypomanic symptoms may be accompanied, but diagnostic criteria for bipolar II disorder are not met.
D009: Binge eating and hypomanic symptoms may be accompanied, but diagnostic criteria for bipolar II disorder are met.
